about.title: Travel guides built around people, not lists.
about.p1: Brooks Prequel is a travel-guide marketplace where creators publish personal itineraries, hidden places, memories, and practical routes that buyers can turn into trips.
about.p2: The product is designed for travelers who want context before they arrive: what to see, what to skip, how to plan a day, and how to move discoveries into maps and calendars without rebuilding everything manually.

academy.title: Creator Academy
academy.intro: Everything you need to publish guides that sell. Follow these standards and your guide will stand out.
academy.photo1: Use RAW or high-resolution JPEG files. Avoid heavy filters.
academy.photo2: Shoot in natural light. Golden hour (1 hour after sunrise / before sunset) gives the best results.
academy.photo3: Landscape 16:9 works best for cover images. Portrait works for place cards.
academy.photo4: Show people experiencing the place, not just the place itself.
academy.photo5: Avoid stock photos — authenticity drives purchases.
academy.writingCuriosityGapDesc: Withhold just enough to make readers want more. Instead of "A good street food area," try "The one stall most tourists walk straight past."
academy.writingSensoryDesc: Replace generic adjectives (beautiful, nice, amazing) with sensory specifics — smell, sound, taste, texture, temperature. "Salt-crusted evening breeze" beats "beautiful beach."
academy.writingContrarianDesc: Break the expected pattern with one surprising take. "Skip the main square — here's why the side street is better" creates instant intrigue.
academy.writingPeakEndDesc: End every day — and the guide — on an emotional high. The last place visitors experience shapes their entire memory of the trip.
academy.structureIntro: Use these block categories to build a complete guide:
academy.secretNote: Secret blocks are only visible to buyers — use them for your best insider tips to drive purchases.
academy.pricing1: Single-city guides: $5–$15. Multi-city or niche expertise: $15–$30.
academy.pricing2: Price below what a travel agent would charge for 30 minutes of the same advice.
academy.pricing3: Launch at a lower price to collect reviews, then raise once you have social proof.
academy.pricing4: Limited-time sales (24–72 hours) create urgency and drive initial purchases.
